title: 1. Data and Model Health — Offline
description: Offline source inventory and stored prediction provenance. This dashboard does not check service health or model quality.

list.name: platform
list.label: Platform
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(platform, '') AS __text, COALESCE(platform, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: country
list.label: Country
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(country, '') AS __text, COALESCE(country, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(acquisition_channel, '') AS __text, COALESCE(acquisition_channel, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: goal
list.label: Goal
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(onboarding_goal, '') AS __text, COALESCE(onboarding_goal, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: flow
list.label: Flow
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(flow, '') AS __text, COALESCE(flow, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: test
list.label: Test
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ab_test, '') AS __text, COALESCE(ab_test, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_name AS "Source", row_count AS "Rows", LEFT(sha256, 12) AS "SHA-256 prefix", imported_at AS "Imported UTC" FROM offline_imports ORDER BY source_name

panels.title: Stored prediction sources
panels.description: Stored synthetic predictions by source, model and version. These rows do not verify that the inference service is running or approved for real customers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT prediction_source AS "Source", model_id AS "Model ID", model_version AS "Version", COUNT(*) AS "Stored predictions" FROM churn_predictions GROUP BY prediction_source, model_id, model_version UNION ALL SELECT 'external' AS "Source", 'No external predictions stored' AS "Model ID", NULL AS "Version", 0 AS "Stored predictions" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'external') ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT date_trunc('day',u.install_at) AS "time", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Installed users" FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Selected segment size
panels.description: Denominator for this segment, not model coverage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users in selected segment" FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test'
